I work on applied research problems where the statistics are only half the
difficulty — the other half is that the data was collected by people, for
reasons that had nothing to do with your question.

Right now I'm interested in measurement: what a number has to survive before
it deserves to be acted on. That pulls me across sampling design, time series
drift, and the interfaces that put estimates in front of people who have to
decide something.

Outside of that I build small tools, write [here](blog/index.qmd), and keep a
graveyard of [prototypes](prototypes/index.qmd).

## Tools

Daily: R, Python, Quarto, SQL, git.
Comfortable: Stan, Shiny, Observable, Docker.
Occasionally: whatever the problem demands.

## Elsewhere

The fastest way to reach me is email. I read everything and answer most things,
usually slowly.
